flawless: Every forest answered me, and you could not hold back the green.
Yavimaya taught me the forests' voice. You never heard what they were saying.
Not a leaf of me touched. Go, and walk more gently under the trees.
solid: You wounded me, but every root in Llanowar lent me its strength.
Multani himself would have admired that fight. Barely.
close: The forests are quiet now, as if they held their breath. So did I.
That was too near, stranger. Even my trees tremble at you.
